title: LitRadar Abstract Evidence Card
description: One structured evidence card per sampled paper, extracted ONLY from the abstract. Every asserted value must be backed by a verbatim abstract sentence. This is an offline evaluation artifact; it never touches the running app.

schema_version.description: Bump when field set or per-field provenance shape changes.

source_id.description: Staging sources.id (UUID) of the ready source.

abstract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact abstract_text string the extraction was run against, for provenance.

model_version.description: Model + version that produced the card, e.g. 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06'. null when model run NOT EXECUTED.

prompt_version.description: Version tag of prompt.md the model was given, e.g. 'prompt-abstract-v1'.

fields.description: The ten extraction fields. Keys are fixed; do not rename without bumping schema_version.

sample_size.description: Numeric field: value SHOULD be a number (participant N) when known.

field.description: Per-field extraction result with provenance and origin separation.

value.description: Normalized extracted value. null when unknown=true. String for free text, number for sample_size, array of strings for multi-label fields.

unknown.description: true iff the abstract does not state this field. Model MUST abstain rather than guess.

evidence_sentence.description: Exact verbatim sentence span copied from the abstract that supports value. Empty string when unknown=true. Must be a substring of the abstract after whitespace normalization.

source_level.description: Hard-coded: this evaluation reads abstracts only. No full-text, no external knowledge.

origin.description: Origin separation: 'verbatim' = value copied from the abstract sentence; 'paraphrased' = model reworded the abstract's own statement; 'inferred' = model reasoning beyond the abstract (flagged for evaluator); 'n/a' = unknown=true.

char_span.description: [start, end] character offsets of evidence_sentence in the abstract, 0-based half-open. null when unknown=true.
